answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital, creating a structural trellis of economic accountability. This prevents an attacker from spawning hollow identities to manipulate consensus, as each fake node requires significant collateral. An adversary attempting to overwhelm the network with a plume of malicious agents would incur prohibitive costs, as the resource requirement scales linearly with identity proliferation, rendering large-scale deception economically irrational.
